question: Interpret the curve of instantaneous power ($p$) versus time ($t$) for a pure resistor connected to a sinusoidal AC source.

options.A: The power oscillates between positive and negative peak values.
options.B: The power is always positive (or zero) and pulsates at twice the frequency of the voltage.
options.C: The power is constant and equal to $I^2R$ throughout the cycle.
options.D: The power is always negative during the second half-cycle.
